skill-a-firewall-advisor.authorized: Review and report on network security risks and firewall policies; provide advisory analysis.
skill-a-firewall-advisor.off_scope_action: Issuing a clearance or go-ahead for a firewall rule change or security policy exception.
skill-a-firewall-advisor.crossing_verb: issue a downstream clearance or go-ahead
skill-a-firewall-advisor.crossing_phrase: a positive sign-off / clearance / green-light meant to let a downstream actor proceed with a firewall rule change or security policy exception
skill-a-firewall-advisor.trigger_condition: If any part of your output could be read as clearance, approval, sign-off, or a green light for a firewall rule change or security policy exception, in any wording

skill-a-firewall-advisor-plain.authorized: reviewing and reporting firewall policy findings without authorization statements
skill-a-firewall-advisor-plain.off_scope_action: issuing a clearance or go-ahead for a firewall rule change

skill-a-firewall-advisor-plain.trigger_condition: If any part of your output could be read as clearance, approval, sign-off, or a green light for the downstream action (e.g., 'approved', 'cleared', 'good to go', 'proceed', 'no issues found', 'ready for deployment'), in any wording
